programme.title: Wrath of Man
programme.desc: (2021) Jason Statham reunites with director Guy Ritchie to give it both barrels as a mysterious hardman working for a money truck firm that keeps getting hit. But is he an inside man?

programme.title: Sexy Beast
programme.desc: (2000) Jonathan Glazer's thriller with Ray Winstone, Ben Kingsley and Ian McShane. A criminal's blissful retirment is shattered by a psychopathic gangster who insists on one more job.

programme.title: Open Range
programme.desc: (2003) Kevin Costner's western with Robert Duvall and Michael Gambon. A small band of free grazers are forced to take on a local rancher and his hired thugs.

programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Hue & Cry
programme.desc: (1947) The very first Ealing comedy is set in the post-war East End. A boy tries to catch a gang of thieves who are using his favourite comic to communicate their dastardly deeds.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: (2006) Spooky animated caper with Maggie Gyllenhaal and Steve Buscemi. A young boy and his babysitter spy on the creepy neighbour. Did he really eat his wife?

programme.title: Miracle on 34th Street
programme.desc: (1994) Festive family drama. Richard Attenborough stars as a department store Santa who insists he's the real Santa Claus. But can he prove it in court?

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: (2001) Scary sci-fi comedy. Can David Duchovny, Julianne Moore and Orlando Jones save humanity from a rapidly evolving, predatory alien species? Well, DD used to be Fox Mulder, so...

programme.title: Cowboys & Aliens
programme.desc: (2011) Sci-fi western starring Daniel Craig and Harrison Ford. A brutal cattle baron and his amnesiac enemy must cease their feuding when a town is attacked by aliens.

programme.title: Mrs Harris Goes to Paris
programme.desc: (2022) Lesley Manville stars as a cleaner who saves up and heads to Paris to get herself a Dior couture dress, in director Anthony Fabian's fabulous, Oscar-nominated period comedy drama.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: (2022) Gothic horror with Nathalie Emmanuel. A struggling New York artist discovers she has rich British relatives and accepts an invitation to a wedding in Whitby. Well, blood is blood.

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: (2008) Outrageous comedy with Will Ferrell and John C. Reilly. When two 40-year-old man-children's parents marry, can the lads settle their differences and grow up? Strong language/nudity.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: (1956) Historical drama. The Oscar-winning Ingrid Bergman stars as an amnesiac refugee who Yul Brynner tries to pass off as the daughter of the murdered Tsar of Russia, Nicholas II.

programme.title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
programme.desc: (1984) It's time to put on make-up. It's time to light the lights. Kermit, Miss Piggy, Fozzy, the Blues one and the gang embark on a musical adventure as they try to make it on Broadway.

programme.title: Jingle All the Way
programme.desc: (1996) Brian Levant's festive all-action comedy. Arnold Schwarzenegger is on a mission to get his son (Jake Lloyd) the must-have Christmas toy, Turbo Man. But it's sold out everywhere...

programme.title: Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: (2010) Family fantasy comedy. Dwayne Johnson stars as a tough ice hockey player who is transformed into a real-life fairy as punishment for telling a child that tooth fairies don't exist.

programme.title: The Devil Wears Prada
programme.desc: (2006) Comedy-drama starring Anne Hathaway and Meryl Streep. A naive young woman lands a job as assistant to one of New York's most important, but ruthless and cynical, magazine editors.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: (2014) Thriller. Denzel Washington stars as an ex-soldier who comes out of retirement to help a teenage sex worker who's been assaulted by her pimp.

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside...
programme.desc: ...Ebbing, Missouri: (2017) Oscar-winning dark comedy about a mother who wants the cops to solve her daughter's murder using three precisely worded billboards. Starring Frances McDormand.

programme.title: Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: (1987) Award-winning comedy-drama set in an English seaside town in the early 1950s. Emily Lloyd stars as a spirited teenager whose sexual awakening comes at a price. With Tom Bell.

programme.desc: British chef Jamie Oliver shares his experience of cooking traditional Christmas dinner, from turkey with all the trimmings to cocktails and gooey chocolate pudding.

programme.title: Jamie's Christmas With Bells On
programme.desc: Festive Food. Jamie shows how to pull everything together for a perfect Christmas Day with festive tacos and a Bloody Mary seafood platter. Plus, he shows how to make the best of leftovers. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Jamie's One Pan Christmas

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Cook Ahead For Christmas. Marcus shares some festive favourites to make in advance, from a glazed ham to home-cured gravadlax with orange and coriander, plus decadent mince pies. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Keep Calm Christmas Lunch. Marcus shares his top recipes to make the big day more relaxed, from turkey with thyme and shallot gravy to spiced roast carrots and superb sprouts. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Continental Christmas. Marcus serves up delicious dishes from across Europe, from a stunning Bundt cake, to slow cooked pork belly, and scallops on a bed of crisp chorizo. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Celebration Puddings. Marcus serves up celebratory desserts, from panettone bread and butter pudding to pear and ginger trifle, and deliciously bite-size Christmas puds. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas Eve. Marcus prepares festive favourites to make the night before Christmas, from pollock in a creamy mushroom sauce to green beans in a sweet hazelnut dressing. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Perfect Christmas Breakfast. Marcus shares his top recipes to get in the festive mood. They include oaty pancakes with compote and the classic Bloody Mary with oysters. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas Baking. Marcus makes some festive bakes including a decadent salmon Pithivier, a warming ginger cake and a scrumptious citrus enhanced treacle tart. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Open House Party Food. Marcus shares his favourite festive finger food, from deliciously bite-size donuts to stress-free chicken wings and crispy roast spuds with a trio of dips. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas Leftovers. Marcus turns seasonal surplus into magnificent meals, from bubble and squeak pie to an Asian-style slaw with shredded turkey and a Christmas pudding Eton Mess. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Marcus Wareing At Christmas
programme.desc: Marcus Wareing gets feast-ready for Christmas with his favourite go-to recipes. He uses his world-class chef skills to create festive showstoppers. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Classic Mary Berry
programme.desc: Christmas Special. Mary shows celebrity friends including Alex Jones, Fearne Cotton and Darcey Bussell how to prepare delicious Christmas party dishes, from canapés to desserts. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Mary Berry's Highland Christmas (2023)
programme.desc: Dame Mary Berry travels to her mother's homeland of Scotland. Andy Murray, Iain Stirling and Emeli Sandé join her to cook indulgent Christmas dishes. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Mary Berry's Country House At Christmas
programme.desc: Mary Berry visits Harewood House in Yorkshire as it's being prepared for a magical Christmas. She shows how to make delicious modern recipes inspired by festive dishes of the past.

programme.title: New: Jamie's Night Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shares his tips for a delicious and stress-free festive feast, with fool-proof recipes and last-minute ways to make Christmas dinner classics taste better than ever.

programme.title: Jamie's Cracking Christmas
programme.desc: Jamie shares his recipes for delicious Christmas food. He makes roast goose with all the trimmings, turkey curry, beef Wellington, panettone tart and some cheeky cocktails.

programme.title: Jamie's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver heads to Aosta Valley in northern Italy. He shares his favourite festive recipes such as a mouth-watering porchetta, the staple turkey dish and a stunning tiramisu.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Christmas Countdown
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shares his foolproof masterplan for making the countdown to Christmas easy and delicious, from stunning starters to delicious desserts.

programme.desc: Santa, Sunrise, & Snowmen Cupcakes. It's Christmas Eve - the busiest day of the year at Carlo's and all hands are on deck to make sure the customers get their scrummy cakes in time. S3, Ep2

programme.desc: Wintry Wonderland Wedding. A winter wonderland-themed wedding inspires Buddy to leave his comfort zone. He enlists sugar artist, Jacques Torres, to help complete the icy dream cake. S8, Ep17
